document.about: LAPP innovation catalogue, spring 2026 (36 pages). Page 5 sets its product families in panels, each a name, a sentence about it and photographs, over a background drawn as one group of shapes.

notes: 2026-11-26: the panels were found as one drawing, whose region took in each product's sentence and name as figure text.

checks.issue: #389: the EPIC® panel's sentence was figure text.

element.text: EPIC® industrial connectors can be found everywhere in industrial machinery and plant engineering, for measuring, control and drives.
